verdicts.reason: A: the body copy, badges and legal line are shrunk to unreadable micro-text and crowded together to the right of the logo. The SUNSET SALE ribbon is jammed in among the badges, and the can and logo are tiny, so the right half is a jumbled cluster. B: the CTA is large and the headline reads clearly, but the body copy under the headline is illegible. The badges are unreadable slivers, the legal block is tiny, and the broken 'missing asset / holiday badge' placeholder overlaps the ribbon and is cut off at the edge. B is marginally better because its hierarchy holds up.
